findings.why: This value is the {device} fallback (remoteDeviceLabel) and is substituted before postpositions: remote_on_device '{device} पर' renders 'कोई दूसरा डिवाइस पर' and ui.canvas.files.remoteFetching '{device} से' renders 'कोई दूसरा डिवाइस से', both needing the oblique 'किसी दूसरे डिवाइस'. The invariant adjective 'अन्य' reads correctly in direct and oblique slots ('अन्य डिवाइस पर', 'अन्य डिवाइस जवाब नहीं दे रहा है'). Minor because the code comment says the canonical row always carries an id, so the fallback is a guard, not a produced state.
findings.disposition: open - recorded for the translator; not edited by the auditor
